name: 88012 · Las Cruces, NM
findings: ZIP 88012 (Las Cruces) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88012 (Las Cruces) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 88012 (Las Cruces) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
